note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, one program tag and one top text, so 4 graphics and the end card.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Your old shoes = 50 points. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top third, over the bin shot and then her face. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05 for 2 s, small, lower left above the captions: Rebecca · DSW Newmarket
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Keep it small.

mg.title: Program tag
mg.cue: Program tag at 00:16, upper left, 2 s: 4EveryKid
mg.use: Put it on at 00:16 for 2 s, upper left, over the girl trying on shoes. Spell it 4EveryKid.

mg.title: It's a cycle
mg.cue: Top text at 00:33 for 2 s, top third: It's a cycle.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:33 when she says it and hold 2 s, top third, over the DONATE HERE bin. Keep captions on.
